aiHeadlines: 📊 Sheffield United top the EFL Championship on 18 points after 6 rounds.
🧱 Nobody is harder to score on than Sheffield United: 3 conceded all season.
⚽ Sheffield United have the sharpest attack in the EFL Championship: 13 scored in 4 rounds.

boardObjectives.label: Have 1 player from England in the squad
Have 2 players aged 30 or over in the squad

inbox.text: Tyler Ferreira (Youth) caught you in the corridor. He is down as a rotation option and he has started 0 of the last 5. He wants to know which of those two is the truth.

options.label: Be straight: he is a backup

inbox.text: An agent has been in touch about Tomas Molina, who is 27 and has a year left. The desk prices a new deal at £5.9m up front on 33k a week for 4 years. Say nothing and he can talk to anyone in the summer.
Adem Ahlberg has asked for a meeting about his place in the side. He is training well and he does not think the teamsheet reflects it.

academy.preview: The head of youth likes this group. There should be one worth keeping.

pending.text: The bookmakers have you favourite for the sack. Are you worried about your job?

options.label: I am going nowhere
options.line: Defiant, and the room enjoyed it. The people who actually decide did not.

options.label: The board have backed me all the way
options.line: Loyal to a fault. It bought you time upstairs and bored everybody else.

options.label: Judge me in May
options.line: Nobody got a headline out of it, and the squad heard a manager who is not panicking.

decisions.text: A sponsor wants the squad at a photo shoot on the day off and will pay £200k for the afternoon. The supporters trust has asked for the same afternoon for an open day at the training ground, and the local paper wants to cover it.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: A columnist has written that your side has no plan. The press officer wants to know whether you will answer it.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: The board want you at an investors dinner on Thursday. A paper has asked for a long sit down interview the same evening.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.
